essence.centralIdea: [A short truth that guides every choice.]
essence.purpose: [The concrete change the brand wants to enable.]
essence.tension: [The cultural or human conflict it helps resolve.]
essence.promise: [The experience that should repeat at every touchpoint.]

positioning.statement: For [priority audience], we are the [category] that [distinct benefit], because [proof].
positioning.primaryAudience: [Who experiences the problem and chooses the solution.]
positioning.influencingAudience: [Who recommends, approves, or enables the decision.]

expressionPrinciples.name: Clear, not simplistic.
expressionPrinciples.intent: Reduce effort without erasing nuance. Orient first, then go deeper.
expressionPrinciples.approvedExample: See what changes your decision first.
expressionPrinciples.avoidExample: Discover a revolutionary universe of possibilities.

expressionPrinciples.name: Human, not casual.
expressionPrinciples.intent: Show attention without simulating intimacy. Speak to people, not segments.
expressionPrinciples.approvedExample: Here is what you can do next.
expressionPrinciples.avoidExample: Hey bestie, let’s crush it together!

expressionPrinciples.name: Vivid, not noisy.
expressionPrinciples.intent: Use contrast to create energy. Give one idea at a time room to breathe.
expressionPrinciples.approvedExample: One clear signal leads the composition.

voice.intent: Say what matters with precision and leave a door open.
rules: End with a possible next step.

visual.signatureRule: The name is variable. Proportion is the rule.

imagery.principle: Images reveal relationships; they never act as generic decoration.

directions.name: Presence
directions.description: A clear relationship between subject and space.

directions.name: Material
directions.description: Real texture, directional light, and close detail.

directions.name: Intervention
directions.description: Color as commentary, not as a filter.

imagery.do: Show action, imperfection, and enough context to understand the scene.
imagery.avoid: Obvious stock imagery, staged gestures, and filters that flatten skin tones.

motionAndSound.principle: Enter with direction. Remain at rest.
motionAndSound.sound: Three notes, soft attack, under one second. Use only as a user-enabled confirmation.

informationAndData.principle: Data makes differences legible and decisions verifiable.
rules: Keep value, unit, period, and source together.
Reinforce semantic color with labels or patterns.
Do not use scales that dramatize differences.

accessibility.principle: Brand recognition cannot depend on excluding people.
rules: Use at least 16px for body text and readable line lengths.
Provide visible focus, logical order, and practical touch targets.
Never make information depend on animation, color, or audio alone.
Use direct sentences, text alternatives, and non-exclusionary terms.
boundaries: Never imply certainty where risk exists.
Never decorate critical information at the cost of clarity.

channels.name: Presentations
channels.job: Guide a decision through a narrative sequence.

channels.name: Proposals
channels.job: Turn understanding into a clear agreement.

channels.name: Social
channels.job: Create relevant attention and open a conversation.

channels.name: BI & data
channels.job: Reduce the time between reading and decision.
